title: 3896. Minimum Operations to Transform Array into Alternating Prime

examples.explanation: The element at index 0 must be prime. Increment nums[0] = 1 to 2, using 1 operation. The element at index 1 must be non-prime. Increment nums[1] = 2 to 4, using 2 operations. The element at index 2 is already prime. The element at index 3 is already non-prime. Total operations = 1 + 2 = 3.
The elements at indices 0 and 2 are already prime. The elements at indices 1 and 3 are already non-prime. No operations are needed.
The element at index 0 must be prime. Increment nums[0] = 4 to 5, using 1 operation. The element at index 1 is already non-prime. Total operations = 1.

hints: Each index can be handled independently. Focus on making each element valid with the minimum increments.
For even indices, find the smallest prime >= nums[i].
For odd indices, find the smallest non-prime >= nums[i].
Precompute primes efficiently (e.g., Sieve of Eratosthenes) to quickly check or jump to the next valid number.
For odd indices, note that any number > 2 becomes non-prime after at most 1 increment (except 2).
